result.instructions: Tools for Better Stack, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our websites are down right now?"; "Show me all incidents from the last 7 days and how long each lasted."; "Who is on call for our team right now, and for which schedule?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Better Stack data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run betterstack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run betterstack_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run betterstack_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. betterstack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: betterstack_list_monitors
tools.title: List monitors
tools.description: List uptime monitors with their status (up/down/paused/pending/maintenance/validating), check frequency, and alert settings. Good first call to discover what is being monitored. Uptime API: GET /api/v2/monitors.

url.description: Filter monitors by their monitored URL.

pronounceable_name.description: Filter monitors by their pronounceable name.

team_name.description: Filter by team name (only when using a global API token).

tools.name: betterstack_get_monitor
tools.title: Get a monitor
tools.description: Get a single monitor by id, including current status, last_checked_at, SSL/HTTP settings, regions, and alerting configuration. Uptime API: GET /api/v2/monitors/{id}.

tools.name: betterstack_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List incidents (alerts triggered by monitors/heartbeats), filterable by date range, monitor, and acknowledged/resolved state. Each incident carries cause, started_at, acknowledged_at, resolved_at. Uptime API: GET /api/v3/incidents.

monitor_id.description: Only incidents for this monitor id.

heartbeat_id.description: Only incidents for this heartbeat id.

resolved.description: true = only resolved, false = only unresolved.

acknowledged.description: true = only acknowledged, false = only unacknowledged.

team_name.description: Filter by team name (only when using a global API token).

tools.name: betterstack_get_incident
tools.title: Get an incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by id, including cause, status, timeline timestamps (started/acknowledged/resolved), who acknowledged/resolved it, and the related monitor. Uptime API: GET /api/v3/incidents/{id}.

tools.name: betterstack_list_heartbeats
tools.title: List heartbeats
tools.description: List heartbeats (cron/background-job monitors that expect a periodic ping), with period, grace, and status (up/down/paused/pending). Uptime API: GET /api/v2/heartbeats.

team_name.description: Filter by team name (only when using a global API token).

tools.name: betterstack_list_on_call
tools.title: List on-call schedules
tools.description: List on-call calendars/schedules and the users currently on call for escalation. Useful to see who gets paged. Uptime API: GET /api/v2/on-calls.

team_name.description: Filter by team name (only when using a global API token).

tools.name: betterstack_list_status_pages
tools.title: List status pages
tools.description: List public/private status pages with company name, subdomain, aggregate_state, and published flag. Uptime API: GET /api/v2/status-pages.

team_name.description: Filter by team name (only when using a global API token).

tools.name: betterstack_acknowledge_incident
tools.title: Acknowledge an incident
tools.description: Acknowledge an ongoing incident, signalling that someone is looking into it (stops further escalation). Idempotent-ish: acknowledging an already-acknowledged incident returns HTTP 409. Uptime API: POST /api/v3/incidents/{id}/acknowledge.

incident_id.description: The incident id to acknowledge (from betterstack_list_incidents).

acknowledged_by.description: User e-mail or a custom identifier of who is acknowledging the incident.

tools.name: betterstack_resolve_incident
tools.title: Resolve an incident
tools.description: Resolve an ongoing incident, marking it as handled/closed. Idempotent-ish: resolving an already-resolved incident returns HTTP 409. Uptime API: POST /api/v3/incidents/{id}/resolve.

incident_id.description: The incident id to resolve (from betterstack_list_incidents).

resolved_by.description: User e-mail or a custom identifier of who is resolving the incident.
